Superconducting artificial atoms

  • 58 TE Full-Rank Noise Forbids Long-Range Entanglement Swapping
    Xuan Du Trinh, Nicholas Pardave, Angie Huang et al. · 2026-09-10
    Proves full-rank noise caps entanglement-swapping depth; superconducting-processor experiment shows rank-deficient links sustain concurrence where full-rank ones cannot.

Quantum optics on other platforms

  • 63 E On-chip squeezed light in the audio frequency band
    Xuezhi Zhu, Yunyun Cao, Rui Liu et al. · 2026-09-10

entry.title: Thursday 10 September 2026: 1 to read, 12 worth the title
entry.content:
Superconducting artificial atoms

  • 84 E Experimental realization of quantum-computing-enhanced sensing
    Yifang Xu, Hongwei Huang, Yilong Zhou et al. · 2026-09-07
    Runs Grover search inside a microwave cavity of 128+ photons, with a transmon sensor turning an unknown signal into the oracle.
  • 72 T Non-Hermitian topology in driven-dissipative systems: correspondence with quantum correlations and a resource for entanglement
    Niladri Chakraborty, Clara C. Wanjura · 2026-09-08
    Shows non-Hermitian topological amplifiers produce exponentially growing correlations between modes while entanglement stays local.
  • 62 T Recovering Readout-Limited Fisher Information in Superconducting-Qubit Magnetometry with Squeezed Microwaves
    M. -R. Yun, Y. -J. Qu, Zheng Shan et al. · 2026-09-08
    Computes how squeezed-microwave dispersive readout recovers Fisher information lost in qubit state assignment, 27 percent sensitivity gain.
  • 55 T Robustness of Dynamical Casimir Effect-Induced Quantum Synchronization
    Sebastián Francisquez, Fernando C. Lombardo, Paula I. Villar · 2026-09-04
    Tests whether dynamical-Casimir-induced synchronization of two qubits survives realistic cQED loss, dephasing dominates.
  • 55 TE Strong-Drive Limits in Josephson Circuits: From Chaos to an Unbound-Resonance Threshold
    Xinyuan You, Aniket Maiti, Yao Lu · 2026-09-04
    Maps chaos and unbound-resonance thresholds for strongly driven Josephson circuits and confirms the flux-bias dependence in a SQUID.

Quantum optics on other platforms

  • 75 E Efficient Conversion of Optical to Mechanical States Close to the Single-Quantum Level
    Alexander Rolf Korsch, Liu Chen, Pedro V. Pinho et al. · 2026-09-03
    Converts few-photon optical pulses to phonons at 76 percent efficiency in a millikelvin optomechanical crystal, HBT confirms coherence.
  • 70 E Spin-to-polarization mapping with a coherent quantum dot-cavity receiver
    Adrià Medeiros, Vincent Vinel, Eliott Rambeau et al. · 2026-09-03
    A single reflected photon projects a quantum-dot spin with 95 percent fidelity via spin-dependent Kerr rotation.
  • 68 E Telecom-Integrated Photonic Memory Operating Near the Mechanical Ground State
    Jindao Tang, Bo Jing, Liping Zeng et al. · 2026-09-06
    On-chip optomechanical memory stores telecom photons at 0.32 phonon occupancy with on-demand retrieval.
  • 58 E Dual-Trigger of Series Nanowire Detector for Event-Based Photon Number Assignment
    Stefanie Grotowski, Daniel Landes, Fabian Wietschorke et al. · 2026-09-08
    Rising and falling edge triggering on a series SNSPD assigns photon number 1 to 3 per event and shows jitter falls with n.
  • 55 E Generation of entanglement statistics with a large-scale integrated photonic-electronic circuit
    Volkan Gurses, Ali Hajimiri · 2026-09-06
    Mixes homodyne photocurrents from squeezed vacuum in a 32-channel RF network to certify two-mode entanglement electronically.
  • 55 T Topological Edge States and Collective Radiation in a One-Dimensional Atomic Chain
    Arda Deniz İyican, Ahmet Levent Subaşı, Özgür Çakır · 2026-09-07
    Diatomic emitter chain in vacuum hosts topological edge states alongside sub- and superradiant modes, with far-field signatures.
  • 50 T Finite-energy Gottesman-Kitaev-Preskill state-enhanced optical interferometry
    Ashmita Roy, R. Srikanth, Deepak Pandey · 2026-09-07
    Finite-energy GKP input beats squeezed vacuum in SU(2) and SU(1,1) interferometers at fixed envelope width.
  • 50 T Fast universal parametric spin control in an acoustically modulated quantum dot
    Mateusz Kuniej, Michał Gawełczyk · 2026-09-04
    Parametric acoustic modulation of a dressed quantum-dot spin gives 155 ps X gates with arbitrary rotation axes.
